Subject: Intro to economic buyer / budget owner - Horizon AI (post-discovery)

Hi Aisha 

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Use case: automating LLM-powered release notes, agent summarization for product team workflows.
- Scale: ~10M tokens/month projected in pilot, likely to grow if latency/cost look good.
- Primary success criteria: 95th pct latency below 500ms, predictable token cost under $0.003/unit, and no data residency blockers.

As discussed, the next step for procurement is an intro to the economic buyer / budget owner so we can align on pricing and procurement cadence. Could you please introduce me to the person who owns budget approvals for third-party inference services (or loop in procurement)?

I'm attaching a draft mutual action plan and our latest pricing sheet for reference. If helpful, proposed next steps:
1) Intro to econ buyer + procurement (15-30 min)  align on procurement timeline and contract needs
2) Technical session with Rishi for latency/infra questions (30 min)
3) Pilot SOW / PO timeline discussion

Proposed times next week (PST): Tue 4/20 10:00-11:00 or Wed 4/21 14:00-15:00. Happy to be flexible.

Thanks!
—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147

Hi Lena / Sana / Procurement team 

Thanks for the quick intro, Aisha. Lena / team  great to e-meet you.

I've attached a one-page mutual action plan and a concise pilot pricing summary to give a sense of costs and milestones (attached again). High-level pilot proposal: 6-week pilot capped at 10M tokens, with optional scale pricing tiers if usage exceeds the cap. The attached pricing doc includes three consumption bands and optional burst capacity.

For the budget conversation, an initial ask would be to secure approval for the pilot cap (PO amount) and confirm procurement timelines for SOW + PO processing. If it helps, typical procurement questions we see:
- Data residency and retention (we can support regionally-hosted logs and configurable retention windows)
- SOC 2 and encryption at rest/in transit (we can provide reports and attestations)
- IP / data ownership language in standard SOW (we accept customer data ownership clauses)

Proposed short meeting windows (PST): Wed 4/21 10:00-10:30, Wed 4/21 15:00-15:30, Thu 4/22 09:00-09:30. Rishi (cc) will join for any infra/latency questions. Please let us know what works and we will send a calendar invite.

Looking forward to aligning.

Best
